text:
Ellie: Quick sync — final handoff for the cloud marketplace/catalog launch next Tue. We need partner-approved press assets, one-pager copy, and the joint landing page by EOD Fri. Can owners confirm?

Raj: @Ellie noted. For SI partners we also need the integration usage examples and a short tech quote from their CTO. Is that on our tracker?

Taylor: Landing page draft is in Figma -> https://www.figma.com/file/xxxx/catalog-launch
Taylor: Blog/post schedule proposal: embargoed blog on Tues morning, partner quote snippets live as sidebars. Any objections? :calendar:

Marta: Design can finalize hero + partner logos if we get a clean vector pack. @Andre can you confirm partners will provide SVGs and logo guidelines by Thu?

Andre: Yep, pinged the hardware partner PMs yesterday. Expecting SVGs from two vendors by Wed, one pending contract sign-off. Also flag: marketplace listing requires a short 120-char description + 500-char overview per cloud marketplace rules. I'll add to the tracker.

Raj: For pressOps — do we have an embargo time? we should coordinate with partner comms to avoid overlap with their product calendar.

press-ops-bot: Reminder: Press playbook step 3 (embargo coordination) incomplete. Please confirm contact and embargo time in the playbook board: https://ourboard.company/boards/marketplace-launch

Ellie: Proposed embargo: Tue 09:00 PT. Partners need to confirm by Fri EOD. If anyone expects pushback, flag now.

Taylor: Fine with that. Also proposing a short partner Q&A doc (2-3 bullets) to go in the marketplace listing and blog. I'll draft and share by tomorrow.

Marta: I'll attach hero variations and the responsive CTA in that Figma file. Will include alt copy for accessibility.

Andre: Quick technical checklist I'm pushing to the tracker:
```
- Verify marketplace API key flow
- SI integration sample app (docker) tested against staging
- Telemetry opt-in clear in UI
- Model runtime region parity verified
```
I'll mark blockers in the tracker.

Raj: For the press kit: can product marketing produce a 1-paragraph summary + 3 bullets of customer value and a snappy quote? @Taylor you good to own?

Taylor: I'll own the summary + blog draft. Need partner quote drafts from partners by Thu noon.

Ellie: Action items recap:
- Partners: SVGs + quote drafts (Thu noon) — Andre to chase
- Taylor: blog + summary (tomorrow)
- Marta: final design assets (Thu)
- Andre: checklist verification + tracker updates (ongoing)
- All: confirm embargo by Fri EOD

Ellie: If no major issues we'll lock assets on Fri and do a dry-run publish internally Mon. Thanks team! :rocket:
